tasks.subject: Task 1: Pure filtering/sorting/count-summary logic
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Extract and unit-test filterBySystemIndices, filterAndSortByName, countByStatus, and buildIndexCountSummary as plain functions.

**Files:**
- Create: libs/maia-ui-workspace/projects/maia-elasticsearch/src/lib/elastic-indices/state/elastic-indices-filtering.ts
- Test: libs/maia-ui-workspace/projects/maia-elasticsearch/src/lib/elastic-indices/state/elastic-indices-filtering.spec.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] filterBySystemIndices drops '.'-prefixed indices when hideSystemIndices true
- [ ] filterAndSortByName case-insensitive substring match on indexName, alphabetical sort
- [ ] countByStatus groups by lowercased health.status, skips missing status
- [ ] buildIndexCountSummary produces 'N indices'/'X of N indices' plus ordered (green, yellow, red, then alpha) non-zero status segments

**Verify:** `npx ng test maia-elasticsearch` (from libs/maia-ui-workspace/) — elastic-indices-filtering.spec.ts passes

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wire the store to the new logic, filter, and error state
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: libs/maia-ui-workspace/projects/maia-elasticsearch/src/lib/elastic-indices/state/elastic-indices-page-store.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] nameFilter (default '') and error (default null) added to state
- [ ] toggleFilteredIndexStateDtos/visibleIndexStateDtos/statusCounts/countSummary computed as specified
- [ ] onNameFilterChanged patches nameFilter directly, no debounce
- [ ] fetch success clears error, fetch failure sets error message
- [ ] retryFetch() re-invokes fetchAllIndices()
